transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um, well, student health actually sent me here. They said my weight is too low to clear me for the youth workshops I'm supposed to be doing. I guess the number has kept dropping, but... I don't know, to me it just feels like what happens when I’m really focused and busy with things.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?

Yes, I am. Honestly, just the idea of gaining even a single pound makes me panic. If I were to sit down and eat a normal dinner, or have something cooked with butter, I feel like everyone would immediately be able to see it on me. They'd just know that I've completely lost my discipline.
When you look at your body, do you feel fat?

Um, yeah, I do. It's... it's kind of all I focus on. Like, when I look at photos from our recent showcase, I don't even really see the artwork first. I just immediately zoom in on my arms and my waist. If I look small enough in those pictures, then I feel like I’m serious and put-together. But if I don't, I just feel like I'm failing.
Do you ever make yourself vomit after eating?
No, I don't do that. I just try to control what I eat in the first place, so I don't really feel the need to do anything like that.
Have you been deliberately eating much less than your body needs in order to lose weight or keep from gaining it?

Yeah, I do. I basically plan my whole day around not really eating. I'll just have coffee before going to the studio, and... maybe a few bites of something from the café if people are around and watching me. But I definitely avoid bread, or anything oily. It just feels like eating that kind of stuff would completely undo all the control I’ve worked for.
Are you currently at a significantly low body weight for your height?

Well, student health actually sent me here because they say my weight is too low. They wouldn't clear me to help with the youth workshops because of it. The number on the scale has kept dropping, I guess, but to me... it just feels like what naturally happens when I’m really focused and busy with everything.
